title: Lead AWS DevOps Engineer
description: We are looking for a Lead AWS DevOps Engineer to shape and evolve shared cloud platform services used across product and application teams. You will treat the platform as a product by delivering reusable building blocks, paved roads, and a consistent developer experience aligned with CCoE standards. Responsibilities Design reusable platform capabilities, including shared services, standard compute patterns, and golden baselines, to enable safe and fast workload onboarding Operate and improve centralized services such as logging, monitoring, secrets, identity, file transfers, and key management Create paved roads and golden paths in partnership with product teams, security, and operations Coordinate with Cloud DevOps/Automation engineers to codify platform interfaces in IaC and pipelines Op
